title: Softener Salt Refill Runway Under Two Weeks
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watersoftener:status
| stats latest(days_of_salt_left) as days_of_salt_left by unit
| where days_of_salt_left<14
| sort days_of_salt_left
description: Uses Water-softener consumable tracking telemetry to monitor how much salt runway remains in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for systems that are about to need a refill, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Water-softener consumable tracking data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Unit table of days of salt remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how much salt runway remains so you can spot systems that are about to need a refill before it becomes annoying.
